notes_summary: Early-stage SMB building latency-sensitive in-app streaming assistant; landed via self-serve. Likely to convert to paid hosted API if latency & cost checks out. Primary concerns: streaming latency, p95 SLO, SOC2.
crm_notes: Inbound from docs: signed up trial org 2026-03-05; spun up hosted endpoint and ran small prototype.
Product call 2026-03-08 w/ Elena M. - priority: low-latency streaming in-app assistant for B2B SaaS product.
Current stack: Next.js front-end, Go microservices backend; running on GCP (us-central1).
Beta footprint: ~2k DAU; production target ~50-200 RPS at peak sessions.
Latency SLO: p50 first token <150ms, p95 end-to-end <500ms; streaming is non-negotiable.
Cost sensitivity: tight budget for initial 6 months; asked for batching/caching recommendations and cost breakdown for 100k tokens/mo.
Model preference: lean toward open-weight variants (Mistral/Llama family) hosted by Redwood; open to Redwood-verified quantized variants.
Routing/fallback: wants automatic fallback to smaller model for non-sensitive queries and explicit routing by cost tier.
Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs, retention controls; no on-prem/air-gapped option required.
AE notes: engineering-first buyer persona; prefers code samples and perf numbers over slides.
Quote from Elena: 'We need the assistant to feel instant — UX drops if first token >200ms.'
